outgoing.name: United Kingdom
outgoing.excerpt: Although not the United Kingdom's longest trail, it is according to the Ramblers' Association "one of Britain's best known and toughest".

outgoing.name: United States
outgoing.excerpt: The path was the idea of the journalist and rambler Tom Stephenson, inspired by similar trails in the United States, particularly the Appalachian Trail.
